将一张照片变成带纹理的 3D 网格

在 Floyo 上打开这个可立即运行的工作流程。无需安装。

它是如何运作的

第 1 步：上传您的照片。显示清晰场景或环境的任何单张图像。任何宽度超过 2048px 的内容都会为您调整大小。适用于：室内 · 景观 · 街道 · 建筑

第 2 步：点击运行。无需提示。 MoGe 2 估计场景的深度和几何形状，并从中构建 3D 网格。

步骤 3. 检查您的地图。您可以获得五个预览：彩色深度、原始深度、OpenGL 法线、DirectX 法线和蒙版。下载前使用它们检查几何形状。

步骤 4. 下载 GLB。带纹理的网格另存为标准 GLB 文件。适用于：Blender · Unity · Unreal · 任何 GLB 查看器

第一次？将所有设置保留原样。默认值（分辨率级别 9·全网格细节·纹理打开）对于几乎每个人来说都是正确的起点。

概述

此工作流程使用 MoGe 2（微软研究院的开源几何模型）将单张照片转换为纹理 3D 网格（CVPR 2025 Oral）。它读取一张图像并一次性预测场景的完整 3D 结构：公制尺度深度、表面法线和点云。然后，工作流程将该点云转换为网格并将其另存为 GLB。公制比例意味着几何形状恢复到现实世界的比例，而不仅仅是相对距离。您需要一张照片，而不是 360 度扫描或摄影测量拍摄。上传它，点击运行，大约 3 秒后网格就会恢复。没有提示，没有要连接的节点。

适用对象：建筑师、游戏开发人员和 3D 艺术家，他们希望在 ComfyUI 中进行单图像网格提取，而无需从头开始连接推理和网格节点。不适用于：完整 360 度重建。这会从一个视点构建几何体，因此相机看不到的内容不在网格中。如果需要所有侧面，请使用摄影测量。

为什么选择弗洛约

Floyo 是浏览器中唯一为团队构建的 ComfyUI 平台。

  • 专为团队打造。在整个团队中共享运行历史记录、文件和模型。队友会打开您的确切路线并从您上次停下的地方继续。没有文件交接，没有版本混乱。

  • 无需安装，无需设置。每个工作流程和模型均已预加载。在浏览器中打开它并运行。无需下载，无需配置。

  • 没有本地硬件。工作流程在 H100 NVL GPU 上运行，因此重型模型无需您自己的卡即可快速运行。您的 VRAM 不再是限制。

  • 在一处打开和关闭模型。Floyo 同时运行开源工作流程和 API 模型。

如何使用（在 Floyo 上的浏览器中）

  1. 上传您的照片。

  2. 打跑。无需提示。

  3. 检查深度和正常预览，然后下载 GLB，为任何 3D 应用程序或引擎做好准备。

期望模型已预加载，因此无需下载任何内容。运行它需要一个免费的 Floyo 帐户。每次运行大约 3 秒后返回，因此尝试多张照片可以保持快速。具有清晰深度的场景（房间、街道、风景）提供最干净的网格，而平面主题、微距特写和严重的运动模糊则产生更柔和的几何形状。当您超越默认值时，有两个值得了解的设置：提高游戏引擎中较轻网格的抽取，并在面在深度边缘处破裂时调整不连续性阈值。 MoGe 已获得 MIT 许可，因此您自己图像中的网格可供您用于商业用途。

使用案例

建筑与室内设计。将房间或建筑物的照片转换为网格，您可以遍历、测量或放入演示文稿中。

游戏开发。从参考照片生成环境网格，用于遮挡、天空盒锚点或关卡设计起点。

3D 和运动设计。从照片中提取深度和法线贴图，以在 Blender、Maya 或 C4D 中进行照明参考、位移或投影。

视觉特效和预览。从外景照片构建粗略的 3D 场景，以进行相机匹配和场景扩展，无需摄影测量拍摄。

MoGe 2 可以将什么变成 3D 网格？

o.en:
Turn one photo into a textured 3D mesh

Open this ready-to-run workflow on Floyo. No install needed.

HOW IT WORKS

Step 1. Upload your photo. Any single image showing a clear scene or environment. Anything wider than 2048px is resized for you. Works great with: interiors · landscapes · streets · architecture

Step 2. Hit run. No prompt needed. MoGe 2 estimates the depth and geometry of your scene and builds a 3D mesh from it.

Step 3. Check your maps. You get five previews: colored depth, raw depth, OpenGL normals, DirectX normals, and a mask. Use them to check the geometry before you download.

Step 4. Download your GLB. The textured mesh saves as a standard GLB file. Ready for: Blender · Unity · Unreal · any GLB viewer

First time? Leave every setting as-is. The defaults (resolution level 9 · full mesh detail · texture on) are the right starting point for almost everyone.

Overview

This workflow turns a single photo into a textured 3D mesh using MoGe 2, an open-source geometry model from Microsoft Research (CVPR 2025 Oral). It reads one image and predicts the full 3D structure of the scene in a single pass: metric-scale depth, surface normals, and a point cloud. The workflow then converts that point cloud into a mesh and saves it as a GLB. Metric scale means the geometry comes back at real-world proportions, not just relative distance. You need one photo, not a 360 scan or a photogrammetry shoot. Upload it, hit run, and the mesh comes back in about 3 seconds. No prompt, no nodes to wire.

Who it's for: architects, game developers, and 3D artists who want single-image mesh extraction in ComfyUI without wiring the inference and mesh nodes from scratch. Not for: full 360 reconstruction. This builds geometry from one viewpoint, so what the camera cannot see is not in the mesh. Use photogrammetry if you need all sides.

Why Floyo

Floyo is the only ComfyUI platform built for teams in the browser.

  • Made for teams.Share run history, files, and models across your whole team. A teammate opens your exact run and picks up where you left off. No file handoffs, no version confusion.

  • No install, no setup.Every workflow and model is preloaded. Open it in your browser and run. Nothing to download, nothing to configure.

  • No local hardware.Workflows run on H100 NVL GPUs, so heavy models run fast without a card of your own. Your VRAM stops being the limit.

  • Open and closed models in one place.Floyo runs open-source workflows and API models side by side.

How to use (in your browser on Floyo)

  1. Upload your photo.

  2. Hit run. No prompt needed.

  3. Check the depth and normal previews, then download the GLB, ready for any 3D app or engine.

ExpectationsThe models are preloaded, so there is nothing to download. Running it needs a free Floyo account. Each run comes back in about 3 seconds, so trying several photos stays quick. Scenes with clear depth (rooms, streets, landscapes) give the cleanest meshes, while flat subjects, macro close-ups, and heavy motion blur produce softer geometry. Two settings worth knowing when you go past the defaults: raise decimation for a lighter mesh in a game engine, and adjust the discontinuity threshold if faces break at depth edges. MoGe is MIT licensed, so meshes from your own images are yours to use commercially.

Use Cases

Architecture & Interiors. Turn a photo of a room or building into a mesh you can walk through, measure, or drop into a presentation.

Game Development. Generate environment meshes from reference photos for blockouts, skybox anchors, or level design starting points.

3D & Motion Design. Pull depth and normal maps from a photo for lighting reference, displacement, or projection in Blender, Maya, or C4D.

VFX & Previz. Build rough 3D scenes from location photos for camera matching and set extension, no photogrammetry shoot needed.
